1.zh: 当三十年四[月]初五[日]，以西结在迦巴鲁河边被掳的人中，天就开了，得见　神的异象。
1.en: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

1.zh: 正是约雅斤王被掳去第五年四月初五日，
1.en: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,

1.zh: 在迦勒底人之地、迦巴鲁河边，耶和华的话特特临到布西的儿子祭司以西结；耶和华的灵降在他身上。
1.en: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.

1.zh: 我观看，见狂风从北方刮来，随着有一朵包括闪烁火的大云，周围有光辉；从其中的火内发出好像光耀的精金；
1.en: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.

1.zh: 又从其中显出四个活物的形象来。他们的形状是这样：有人的形象，
1.en: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.

1.zh: 各有四个脸面，四个翅膀。
1.en: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

1.zh: 他们的腿是直的，脚掌好像牛犊之蹄，都灿烂如光明的铜。
1.en: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

1.zh: 在四面的翅膀以下有人的手。这四个活物的脸和翅膀乃是这样：
1.en: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:

1.zh: 翅膀彼此相接，行走并不转身，俱各直往前行。
1.en: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

1.zh: 至于脸的形象：[前面]各有人的脸，右面各有狮子的脸，左面各有牛的脸，[后面]各有鹰的脸。
1.en: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.

1.zh: 各展开上边的两个翅膀相接，各以[下边的]两个[翅膀]遮体。
1.en: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.

1.zh: 他们俱各直往前行。灵往哪里去，他们就往那里去，行走并不转身。
1.en: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.

1.zh: 至于四活物的形象，就如烧着火炭的形状，又如火把的形状。[火]在四活物中间上去下来，这火有光辉，从火中发出闪电。
1.en: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

1.zh: 这活物往来奔走，好像电光一闪。
1.en: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

1.zh: 我正观看活物的时候，见活物的脸旁各有一轮在地上。
1.en: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.

1.zh: 轮的形状和颜色好像水苍玉。四轮都是一个样式，形状和作法好像轮中套轮。
1.en: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

1.zh: 轮行走的时候，向四方都能直行，并不掉转。
1.en: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.

1.zh: 至于轮辋，高而可畏；四个轮辋周围满有眼睛。
1.en: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

1.zh: 活物行走，轮也在旁边行走；活物从地上升，轮也都上升。
1.en: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

1.zh: 灵往哪里去，活物就往那里去；活物上升，轮也在活物旁边上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。
1.en: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

1.zh: 那些行走，这些也行走；那些站住，这些也站住；那些从地上升，轮也在旁边上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。
1.en: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

1.zh: 活物的头以上有穹苍的形象，看着像可畏的水晶，铺张在活物的头以上。
1.en: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

1.zh: 穹苍以下，活物的翅膀直张，彼此相对；每活物有两个翅膀遮体。
1.en: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.

1.zh: 活物行走的时候，我听见翅膀的响声，像大水的声音，像全能者的声音，也像军队哄嚷的声音。活物站住的时候，便将翅膀垂下。
1.en: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.

1.zh: 在他们头以上的穹苍之上有声音。他们站住的时候，便将翅膀垂下。
1.en: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.

1.zh: 在他们头以上的穹苍之上有宝座的形象，仿佛蓝宝石；在宝座形象以上有仿佛人的形状。
1.en: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

1.zh: 我见从他腰以上有仿佛光耀的精金，周围都有火的形状，又见从他腰以下有仿佛火的形状，周围也有光辉。
1.en: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

1.zh: 下雨的日子，云中虹的形状怎样，周围光辉的形状也是怎样。 这就是耶和华荣耀的形象。我一看见就俯伏在地，又听见一位说话的声音。
1.en: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.

2.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，你站起来，我要和你说话。」
2.en: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”

2.zh: 他对我说话的时候，灵就进入我里面，使我站起来，我便听见那位对我说话的[声音]。
2.en: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.

2.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，我差你往悖逆的国民以色列人那里去。他们是悖逆我的，他们和他们的列祖违背我，直到今日。
2.en: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.

2.zh: 这众子面无羞耻，心里刚硬。我差你往他们那里去，你要对他们说：主耶和华如此说。
2.en: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’

2.zh: 他们或听，或不听，（他们是悖逆之家），必知道在他们中间有了先知。
2.en: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.

2.zh: 人子啊，虽有荆棘和蒺藜在你那里，你又住在蝎子中间，总不要怕他们，也不要怕他们的话；他们虽是悖逆之家，还不要怕他们的话，也不要因他们的脸色惊惶。
2.en: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

2.zh: 他们或听，或不听，你只管将我的话告诉他们；他们是极其悖逆的。
2.en: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.

2.zh: 「人子啊，要听我对你所说的话，不要悖逆像那悖逆之家，你要开口吃我所赐给你的。」
2.en: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”

2.zh: 我观看，见有一只手向我伸出来，手中有一书卷。
2.en: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.

2.zh: 他将书卷在我面前展开，内外都写着字，其上所写的有哀号、叹息、悲痛的话。
2.en: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.

3.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，要吃你所得的，要吃这书卷，好去对以色列家讲说。」
3.en: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”

3.zh: 于是我开口，他就使我吃这书卷，
3.en: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.

3.zh: 又对我说：「人子啊，要吃我所赐给你的这书卷，充满你的肚腹。」我就吃了，口中觉得其甜如蜜。
3.en: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then I ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

3.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，你往以色列家那里去，将我的话对他们讲说。
3.en: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.

3.zh: 你奉差遣不是往那说话深奥、言语难懂的民那里去，乃是往以色列家去；
3.en: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—

3.zh: 不是往那说话深奥、言语难懂的多国去，他们的话语是你不懂得的。我若差你往他们那里去，他们必听从你。
3.en: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.

3.zh: 以色列家却不肯听从你，因为他们不肯听从我；原来以色列全家是额坚心硬的人。
3.en: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.

3.zh: 看哪，我使你的脸硬过他们的脸，使你的额硬过他们的额。
3.en: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.

3.zh: 我使你的额像金钢钻，比火石更硬。他们虽是悖逆之家，你不要怕他们，也不要因他们的脸色惊惶。」
3.en: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”

3.zh: 他又对我说：「人子啊，我对你所说的一切话，要心里领会，耳中听闻。
3.en: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.

3.zh: 你往你本国被掳的子民那里去，他们或听，或不听，你要对他们讲说，告诉他们这是主耶和华说的。」
3.en: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”

3.zh: 那时，灵将我举起，我就听见在我身后有震动轰轰的声音，[说]：「从耶和华的所在显出来的荣耀是该称颂的！」
3.en: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be the LORD’s glory from his place.”

3.zh: 我又[听见]那活物翅膀相碰，与活物旁边轮子旋转震动轰轰的响声。
3.en: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

3.zh: 于是灵将我举起，带我而去。我心中甚苦，灵性忿激，并且耶和华的灵在我身上大有能力。
3.en: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and the LORD’s hand was strong on me.

3.zh: 我就来到提勒·亚毕，住在迦巴鲁河边被掳的人那里，到他们所住的地方，在他们中间忧忧闷闷地坐了七日。
3.en: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.

3.zh: 过了七日，耶和华的话临到我说：
3.en: At the end of seven days, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

3.zh: 「人子啊，我立你作以色列家守望的人，所以你要听我口中的话，替我警戒他们。
3.en: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.

3.zh: 我何时指着恶人说：他必要死；你若不警戒他，也不劝戒他，使他离开恶行，拯救他的性命，这恶人必死在罪孽之中；我却要向你讨他丧命的罪。
3.en: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

3.zh: 倘若你警戒恶人，他仍不转离罪恶，也不离开恶行，他必死在罪孽之中，你却救自己脱离了罪。
3.en: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”

3.zh: 再者，义人何时离义而犯罪，我将绊脚石放在他面前，他就必死；因你没有警戒他，他必死在罪中，他素来所行的义不被记念；我却要向你讨他丧命的罪。
3.en: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.

3.zh: 倘若你警戒义人，使他不犯罪，他就不犯罪；他因受警戒就必存活，你也救自己脱离了罪。」
3.en: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”

3.zh: 耶和华的灵在那里降在我身上。他对我说：「你起来往平原去，我要在那里和你说话。」
3.en: The LORD’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”

3.zh: 于是我起来往平原去，不料，耶和华的荣耀正如我在迦巴鲁河边所见的一样，停在那里，我就俯伏于地。
3.en: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, the LORD’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.

3.zh: 灵就进入我里面，使我站起来。耶和华对我说：「你进房屋去，将门关上。
3.en: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

3.zh: 人子啊，人必用绳索捆绑你，你就不能出去在他们中间来往。
3.en: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.

3.zh: 我必使你的舌头贴住上膛，以致你哑口，不能作责备他们的人；他们原是悖逆之家。
3.en: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.

3.zh: 但我对你说话的时候，必使你开口，你就要对他们说：『主耶和华如此说。』听的可以听，不听的任他不听，因为他们是悖逆之家。」
3.en: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”

4.zh: 「人子啊，你要拿一块砖，摆在你面前，将一座耶路撒冷城画在其上，
4.en: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

4.zh: 又围困这城，造台筑垒，安营攻击，在四围安设撞锤攻城，
4.en: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

4.zh: 又要拿个铁鏊，放在你和城的中间，作为铁墙。你要对面攻击这城，使城被困；这样，好作以色列家的预兆。
4.en: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

4.zh: 「你要向左侧卧，承当以色列家的罪孽；要[按]你向左侧卧的日数，担当他们的罪孽。
4.en: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

4.zh: 因为我已将他们作孽的年数定为你[向左侧卧]的日数，就是三百九十日，你要这样担当以色列家的罪孽。
4.en: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

4.zh: 再者，你满了这些日子，还要向右侧卧，担当犹大家的罪孽。我给你定规[侧卧]四十日，一日顶一年。
4.en: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

4.zh: 你要露出膀臂，面向被困的耶路撒冷，说预言攻击这城。
4.en: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

4.zh: 我用绳索捆绑你，使你不能辗转，直等你满了困[城]的日子。
4.en: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.

4.zh: 「你要取小麦、大麦、豆子、红豆、小米、粗麦，装在一个器皿中，用以为自己做饼；要[按]你侧卧的三百九十日吃这饼。
4.en: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

4.zh: 你所吃的要按分两吃，每日二十舍客勒，按时而吃。
4.en: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.

4.zh: 你喝水也要按制子，[每日喝]一欣六分之一，按时而喝。
4.en: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

4.zh: 你吃这饼像吃大麦饼一样，要用人粪在众人眼前烧烤。」
4.en: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

4.zh: 耶和华说：「以色列人在我所赶他们到的各国中，也必这样吃不洁净的食物。」
4.en: The LORD said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”

4.zh: 我说：「哎！主耶和华啊，我素来未曾被玷污，从幼年到如今没有吃过自死的，或被野兽撕裂的，那可憎的肉也未曾入我的口。」
4.en: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”

4.zh: 于是他对我说：「看哪，我给你牛粪代替人粪，你要将你的饼烤在其上。」
4.en: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”

4.zh: 他又对我说：「人子啊，我必在耶路撒冷折断他们的杖，就是断绝他们的粮。他们吃饼要按分两，忧虑而吃；喝水也要按制子，惊惶而喝；
4.en: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;

4.zh: 使他们缺粮缺水，彼此惊惶，因自己的罪孽消灭。」
4.en: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.

5.zh: 「人子啊，你要拿一把快刀，当作剃头刀，用这刀剃你的头发和你的胡须，用天平将须发平分。
5.en: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.

5.zh: 围困[城]的日子满了，你要将三分之一在城中用火焚烧，将三分之一在城的四围用刀砍碎，将三分之一任风吹散；我也要拔刀追赶。
5.en: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

5.zh: 你要从其中取几根包在衣襟里，
5.en: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.

5.zh: 再从这几根中取些扔在火中焚烧，从里面必有火出来烧入以色列全家。
5.en: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.

5.zh: 主耶和华如此说：这就是耶路撒冷。我曾将她安置在列邦之中；列国都在她的四围。
5.en: “The Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.

5.zh: 她行恶，违背我的典章，过于列国；干犯我的律例，过于四围的列邦，因为她弃掉我的典章。至于我的律例，她并没有遵行。
5.en: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’

5.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：因为你们纷争过于四围的列国，也不遵行我的律例，不谨守我的典章，并以遵从四围列国的恶规尚不满意，
5.en: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;

5.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：看哪，我与你反对，必在列国的眼前，在你中间，施行审判；
5.en: therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

5.zh: 并且因你一切可憎的事，我要在你中间行我所未曾行的，以后我也不再照着行。
5.en: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.

5.zh: 在你中间父亲要吃儿子，儿子要吃父亲。我必向你施行审判，我必将你所剩下的分散四方。」
5.en: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.

5.zh: 主耶和华说：「我指着我的永生起誓，因你用一切可憎的物、可厌的事玷污了我的圣所，故此，我定要使[你人数]减少，我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你。
5.en: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.

5.zh: 你的民三分之一必遭瘟疫而死，在你中间必因饥荒消灭；三分之一必在你四围倒在刀下；我必将三分之一分散四方，并要拔刀追赶他们。
5.en: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.

5.zh: 「我要这样成就怒中所定的；我向他们发的忿怒止息了，自己就得着安慰。我在他们身上成就怒中所定的那时，他们就知道我—耶和华所说的是出于热心；
5.en: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, the LORD, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.

5.zh: 并且我必使你在四围的列国中，在经过的众人眼前，成了荒凉和羞辱。
5.en: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.

5.zh: 这样，我必以怒气和忿怒，并烈怒的责备，向你施行审判。那时，你就在四围的列国中成为羞辱、讥刺、警戒、惊骇。这是我—耶和华说的。
5.en: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, the LORD, have spoken it—

5.zh: 那时，我要将灭人、使人饥荒的恶箭，就是射去灭人的，射在你们身上，并要加增你们的饥荒，断绝你们所倚靠的粮食；
5.en: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.

5.zh: 又要使饥荒和恶兽到你那里，叫你丧子，瘟疫和流血的事也必盛行在你那里；我也要使刀剑临到你。这是我—耶和华说的。」
5.en: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, the LORD, have spoken it.’”

6.en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

6.zh: 「人子啊，你要面向以色列的众山说预言，
6.en: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,

6.zh: 说：以色列的众山哪，要听主耶和华的话。主耶和华对大山、小冈、水沟、山谷如此说：我必使刀剑临到你们，也必毁灭你们的邱坛。
6.en: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

6.zh: 你们的祭坛必然荒凉，你们的日像必被打碎。我要使你们被杀的人倒在你们的偶像面前；
6.en: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

6.zh: 我也要将以色列人的尸首放在他们的偶像面前，将你们的骸骨抛散在你们祭坛的四围。
6.en: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

6.zh: 在你们一切的住处，城邑要变为荒场，邱坛必然凄凉，使你们的祭坛荒废，将你们的偶像打碎。你们的日像被砍倒，你们的工作被毁灭。
6.en: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

6.zh: 被杀的人必倒在你们中间，你们就知道我是耶和华。
6.en: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

6.zh: 「你们分散在各国的时候，我必在列邦中使你们有剩下脱离刀剑的人。
6.en: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

6.zh: 那脱离[刀剑]的人必在所掳到的各国中记念我，为他们心中何等伤破，是因他们起淫心，远离我，眼对偶像行邪淫。他们因行一切可憎的恶事，必厌恶自己。
6.en: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

6.zh: 他们必知道我是耶和华；我说要使这灾祸临到他们身上，并非空话。
6.en: They will know that I am the LORD. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’

6.zh: 「主耶和华如此说：你当拍手顿足，说：哀哉！以色列家行这一切可憎的恶事，他们必倒在刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫之下。
6.en: “The Lord GOD says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

6.zh: 在远处的，必遭瘟疫而死；在近处的，必倒在刀剑之下；那存留被围困的，必因饥荒而死；我必这样在他们身上成就我怒中所定的。
6.en: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.

6.zh: 他们被杀的人[倒在]他们祭坛四围的偶像中，就是各高冈、各山顶、各青翠树下、各茂密的橡树下，乃是他们献馨香的祭牲给一切偶像的地方。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。
6.en: You will know that I am the LORD when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.

6.zh: 我必伸手攻击他们，使他们的地从旷野到第伯拉他一切住处极其荒凉，他们就知道我是耶和华。」
6.en: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

7.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
7.en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

7.zh: 「人子啊，主耶和华对以色列地如此说：结局到了，结局到了地的四境！
7.en: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

7.zh: 现在你的结局已经临到，我必使我的怒气归与你，也必按你的行为审判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罚你。
7.en: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

7.zh: 我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你，却要按你所行的报应你，照你中间可憎的事刑罚你。你就知道我是耶和华。
7.en: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’

7.zh: 「主耶和华如此说：有一灾，独有一灾；看哪，临近了！
7.en: “The Lord GOD says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.

7.zh: 结局来了，结局来了，向你兴起。看哪，来到了！
7.en: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.

7.zh: 境内的居民哪，所定的灾临到你，时候到了，日子近了，乃是哄嚷并非在山上欢呼的日子。
7.en: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.

7.zh: 我快要将我的忿怒倾在你身上，向你成就我怒中所定的，按你的行为审判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罚你。
7.en: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

7.zh: 我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你，必按你所行的报应你，照你中间可憎的事刑罚你。你就知道击打你的是我耶和华。
7.en: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, the LORD, strike.

7.zh: 「看哪，看哪，日子快到了；所定的灾已经发出！杖已经开花，骄傲已经发芽。
7.en: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.

7.zh: 强暴兴起，成了罚恶的杖。以色列人，或是他们的群众，或是他们的财宝，无一[存留]；他们中间也没有得尊荣的。
7.en: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.

7.zh: 时候到了，日子近了，买主不可欢喜，卖主不可愁烦，因为烈怒已经临到他们众人身上。
7.en: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.

7.zh: 卖主虽然存活，却不能归回再得所卖的，因为这异象关乎他们众人。谁都不得归回，也没有人在他的罪孽中坚立自己。」
7.en: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

7.zh: 「他们已经吹角，预备齐全，却无一人出战，因为我的烈怒临到他们众人身上。
7.en: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.

7.zh: 在外有刀剑；在内有瘟疫、饥荒。在田野的，必遭刀剑而死；在城中的，必有饥荒、瘟疫吞灭他。
7.en: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.

7.zh: 其中所逃脱的就必逃脱，各人因自己的罪孽在山上发出悲声，好像谷中的鸽子哀鸣。
7.en: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.

7.zh: 手都发软，膝弱如水。
7.en: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.

7.zh: 要用麻布束腰，被战兢所盖；各人脸上羞愧，头上光秃。
7.en: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.

7.zh: 他们要将银子抛在街上，金子看如污秽之物。当耶和华发怒的日子，他们的金银不能救他们，不能使心里知足，也不能使肚腹饱满，因为这金银作了他们罪孽的绊脚石。
7.en: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.

7.zh: 论到耶和华妆饰华美[的殿]，他建立得威严，他们却在其中制造可憎可厌的偶像，所以[这殿]我使他们看如污秽之物。
7.en: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.

7.zh: 我必将[这殿]交付外邦人为掠物，交付地上的恶人为掳物；他们也必亵渎[这殿]。
7.en: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.

7.zh: 我必转脸不顾以色列人，他们亵渎我隐密之[所]，强盗也必进去亵渎。
7.en: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.

7.zh: 「要制造锁链；因为这地遍满流血的罪，城邑充满强暴的事。
7.en: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

7.zh: 所以，我必使列国中最恶的人来占据他们的房屋；我必使强暴人的骄傲止息，他们的圣所都要被亵渎。
7.en: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.

7.zh: 毁灭临近了；他们要求平安，却无平安可得。
7.en: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.

7.zh: 灾害加上灾害，风声接连风声；他们必向先知求异象，但祭司讲的律法、长老设的谋略都必断绝。
7.en: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

7.zh: 君要悲哀，王要披凄凉为衣，国民的手都发颤。我必照他们的行为待他们，按他们应得的审判他们，他们就知道我是耶和华。」
7.en: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

8.zh: 第六年六[月]初五[日]，我坐在家中；犹大的众长老坐在我面前。在那里主耶和华的灵降在我身上。
8.en: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord GOD’s hand fell on me there.

8.zh: 我观看，见有形象仿佛火的形状，从他腰以下的形状有火，从他腰以上有光辉的形状，仿佛光耀的精金。
8.en: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

8.zh: 他伸出仿佛一只手的样式，抓住我的一绺头发，灵就将我举到天地中间，在　神的异象中，带我到耶路撒冷朝北的内[院]门口，在那里有触动[主]怒偶像的坐位，就是惹动忌邪的。
8.en: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

8.zh: 谁知，在那里有以色列　神的荣耀，形状与我在平原所见的一样。
8.en: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

8.zh: 神对我说：「人子啊，你举目向北观看。」我就举目向北观看，见祭坛门的北边，在门口有这[惹]忌邪的偶像；
8.en: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and saw, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

8.zh: 又对我说：「人子啊，以色列家所行的，就是在此行这大可憎的事，使我远离我的圣所，你看见了吗？你还要看见另有大可憎的事。」
8.en: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”

8.zh: 他领我到院门口。我观看，见墙上有个窟窿。
8.en: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

8.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，你要挖墙。」我一挖墙，见有一门。
8.en: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.

8.zh: 他说：「你进去，看他们在这里所行可憎的恶事。」
8.en: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”

8.zh: 我进去一看，谁知，在四面墙上画着各样爬物和可憎的走兽，并以色列家一切的偶像。
8.en: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

8.zh: 在这些像前有以色列家的七十个长老站立，沙番的儿子雅撒尼亚也站在其中。各人手拿香炉，烟云的香气上腾。
8.en: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.

8.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，以色列家的长老暗中在各人画像屋里所行的，你看见了吗？他们常说：『耶和华看不见我们；耶和华已经离弃这地。』」
8.en: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘The LORD doesn’t see us. The LORD has forsaken the land.’”

8.zh: 他又说：「你还要看见他们另外行大可憎的事。」
8.en: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”

8.zh: 他领我到耶和华殿外院朝北的门口。谁知，在那里有妇女坐着，为搭模斯哭泣。
8.en: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.

8.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，你看见了吗？你还要看见比这更可憎的事。」
8.en: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”

8.zh: 他又领我到耶和华殿的内院。谁知，在耶和华的殿门口、廊子和祭坛中间，约有二十五个人背向耶和华的殿，面向东方拜日头。
8.en: He brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house; and I saw at the door of the LORD’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward the LORD’s temple and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.

8.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，你看见了吗？犹大家在此行这可憎的事还算为小吗？他们在这地遍行强暴，再三惹我发怒，他们手拿枝条举向鼻前。
8.en: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.

8.zh: 因此，我也要以忿怒行事，我眼必不顾惜，也不可怜他们；他们虽向我耳中大声呼求，我还是不听。」
8.en: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”

9.zh: 他向我耳中大声喊叫说：「要使那监管这城的人手中各拿灭命的兵器前来。」
9.en: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”

9.zh: 忽然有六个人从朝北的上门而来，各人手拿杀人的兵器；内中有一人身穿细麻衣，腰间带着墨盒子。他们进来，站在铜祭坛旁。
9.en: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.

9.zh: 以色列　神的荣耀本在基路伯上，现今从那里升到殿的门槛。　神将那身穿细麻衣、腰间带着墨盒子的人召来。
9.en: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

9.zh: 耶和华对他说：「你去走遍耶路撒冷全城，那些因城中所行可憎之事叹息哀哭的人，画记号在额上。」
9.en: The LORD said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”

9.zh: 我耳中听见他对其余的人说：「要跟随他走遍全城，以行击杀。你们的眼不要顾惜，也不要可怜他们。
9.en: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.

9.zh: 要将年老的、年少的，并处女、婴孩，和妇女，从圣所起全都杀尽，只是凡有记号的人不要挨近他。」于是他们从殿前的长老杀起。
9.en: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then they began at the old men who were before the house.

9.zh: 他对他们说：「要污秽这殿，使院中充满被杀的人。你们出去吧！」他们就出去，在城中击杀。
9.en: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out, and struck in the city.

9.zh: 他们击杀的时候，我被留下，我就俯伏在地，说：「哎！主耶和华啊，你将忿怒倾在耶路撒冷，岂要将以色列所剩下的人都灭绝吗？」
9.en: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”

9.zh: 他对我说：「以色列家和犹大家的罪孽极其重大。遍地有流血的事，满城有冤屈，因为他们说：『耶和华已经离弃这地，他看不见我们。』
9.en: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘The LORD has forsaken the land, and the LORD doesn’t see.’

9.zh: 故此，我眼必不顾惜，也不可怜他们，要照他们所行的报应在他们头上。」
9.en: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”

9.zh: 那穿细麻衣、腰间带着墨盒子的人将这事回复说：「我已经照你所吩咐的行了。」
9.en: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”

10.zh: 我观看，见基路伯头上的穹苍之中，显出蓝宝石的形状，仿佛宝座的形象。
10.en: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

10.zh: 主对那穿细麻衣的人说：「你进去，在旋转的轮内基路伯以下，从基路伯中间将火炭取满两手，撒在城上。」 我就见他进去。
10.en: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in as I watched.

10.zh: 那人进去的时候，基路伯站在殿的右边，云彩充满了内院。
10.en: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

10.zh: 耶和华的荣耀从基路伯那里上升，[停]在门槛以上；殿内满了云彩，院宇也被耶和华荣耀的光辉充满。
10.en: The LORD’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.

10.zh: 基路伯翅膀的响声听到外院，好像全能　神说话的声音。
10.en: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

10.zh: 他吩咐那穿细麻衣的人说：「要从旋转的轮内基路伯中间取火。」那人就进去站在一个轮子旁边。
10.en: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.

10.zh: 有一个基路伯从基路伯中伸手到基路伯中间的火那里，取些放在那穿细麻衣的人两手中，那人就拿出去了。
10.en: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.

10.zh: 在基路伯翅膀之下，显出有人手的样式。
10.en: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.

10.zh: 我又观看，见基路伯旁边有四个轮子。这基路伯旁有一个轮子，那基路伯旁有一个轮子，每基路伯都是如此；轮子的颜色仿佛水苍玉。
10.en: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.

10.zh: 至于四轮的形状，都是一个样式，仿佛轮中套轮。
10.en: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.

10.zh: 轮行走的时候，向四方都能直行，并不掉转。头向何方，他们也随向何方，行走的时候并不掉转。
10.en: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.

10.zh: 他们全身，连背带手和翅膀，并轮周围都满了眼睛。这四个基路伯的轮子都是如此。
10.en: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.

10.zh: 至于这些轮子，我耳中听见说是旋转的。
10.en: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.

10.zh: 基路伯各有四脸：第一是基路伯的脸，第二是人的脸，第三是狮子的脸，第四是鹰的脸。
10.en: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.

10.zh: 基路伯升上去了；这是我在迦巴鲁河边所见的活物。
10.en: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

10.zh: 基路伯行走，轮也在旁边行走。基路伯展开翅膀，离地上升，轮也不转离他们旁边。
10.en: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.

10.zh: 那些站住，这些也站住；那些上升，这些也一同上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。
10.en: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

10.zh: 耶和华的荣耀从殿的门槛那里出去，停在基路伯以上。
10.en: The LORD’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

10.zh: 基路伯出去的时候，就展开翅膀，在我眼前离地上升。轮也在他们的旁边，都停在耶和华殿的东门口。在他们以上有以色列　神的荣耀。
10.en: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

10.zh: 这是我在迦巴鲁河边所见、以色列　神荣耀以下的活物，我就知道他们是基路伯。
10.en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.

10.zh: 各有四个脸面，四个翅膀，翅膀以下有人手的样式。
10.en: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

10.zh: 至于他们脸的模样，并身体的形象，是我从前在迦巴鲁河边所看见的。他们俱各直往前行。
10.en: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.

11.zh: 灵将我举起，带到耶和华殿向东的东门。谁知，在门口有二十五个人，我见其中有民间的首领押朔的儿子雅撒尼亚和比拿雅的儿子毗拉提。
11.en: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

11.zh: 耶和华对我说：「人子啊，这就是图谋罪孽的人，在这城中给人设恶谋。
11.en: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;

11.zh: 他们说：『盖房屋的时候尚未临近；这城是锅，我们是肉。』
11.en: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’

11.zh: 人子啊，因此你当说预言，说预言攻击他们。」
11.en: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”

11.zh: 耶和华的灵降在我身上，对我说：「你当说，耶和华如此说：以色列家啊，你们口中所说的，心里所想的，我都知道。
11.en: The LORD’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘The LORD says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

11.zh: 你们在这城中杀人增多，使被杀的人充满街道。
11.en: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”

11.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：你们杀在城中的人就是肉，这城就是锅；你们却要从其中被带出去。
11.en: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.

11.zh: 你们怕刀剑，我必使刀剑临到你们。这是主耶和华说的。
11.en: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord GOD.

11.zh: 我必从这城中带出你们去，交在外邦人的手中，且要在你们中间施行审判。
11.en: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

11.zh: 你们必倒在刀下；我必在以色列的境界审判你们，你们就知道我是耶和华。
11.en: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

11.zh: 这城必不作你们的锅，你们也不作其中的肉。我必在以色列的境界审判你们，
11.en: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.

11.zh: 你们就知道我是耶和华；因为你们没有遵行我的律例，也没有顺从我的典章，却随从你们四围列国的恶规。」
11.en: You will know that I am the LORD, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”

11.zh: 我正说预言的时候，比拿雅的儿子毗拉提死了。于是我俯伏在地，大声呼叫说：「哎！主耶和华啊，你要将以色列剩下的人灭绝净尽吗？」
11.en: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord GOD! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”

11.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
11.en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

11.zh: 「人子啊，耶路撒冷的居民对你的弟兄、你的本族、你的亲属、以色列全家，就是对大众说：『你们远离耶和华吧！这地是赐给我们为业的。』
11.en: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from the LORD. This land has been given to us for a possession.’

11.zh: 所以你当说：『耶和华如此说：我虽将以色列全家远远迁移到列国中，将他们分散在列邦内，我还要在他们所到的列邦，暂作他们的圣所。』
11.en: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’

11.zh: 你当说：『主耶和华如此说：我必从万民中招聚你们，从分散的列国内聚集你们，又要将以色列地赐给你们。』
11.en: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”

11.zh: 他们必到那里，也必从其中除掉一切可憎可厌的物。
11.en: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.

11.zh: 我要使他们有合一的心，也要将新灵放在他们里面，又从他们肉体中除掉石心，赐给他们肉心，
11.en: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

11.zh: 使他们顺从我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章。他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的　神。
11.en: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

11.zh: 至于那些心中随从可憎可厌之物的，我必照他们所行的报应在他们头上。这是主耶和华说的。」
11.en: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord GOD.”

11.zh: 于是，基路伯展开翅膀，轮子都在他们旁边；在他们以上有以色列　神的荣耀。
11.en: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

11.zh: 耶和华的荣耀从城中上升，停在城东的那座山上。
11.en: The LORD’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

11.zh: 灵将我举起，在异象中借着　神的灵将我带进迦勒底地，到被掳的人那里；我所见的异象就离我上升去了。
11.en: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

11.zh: 我便将耶和华所指示我的一切事都说给被掳的人听。
11.en: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that the LORD had shown me.

12.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
12.en: The LORD’s word also came to me, saying,

12.zh: 「人子啊，你住在悖逆的家中。他们有眼睛看不见，有耳朵听不见，因为他们是悖逆之家。
12.en: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.

12.zh: 所以人子啊，你要预备掳去使用的物件，在白日当他们眼前从你所住的地方移到别处去；他们虽是悖逆之家，或者可以揣摩思想。
12.en: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

12.zh: 你要在白日当他们眼前带出你的物件去，好像预备掳去使用的物件。到了晚上，你要在他们眼前亲自出去，像被掳的人出去一样。
12.en: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.

12.zh: 你要在他们眼前挖通了墙，从其中将[物件]带出去。
12.en: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.

12.zh: 到天黑时，你要当他们眼前搭在肩头上带出去，并要蒙住脸看不见地，因为我立你作以色列家的预兆。」
12.en: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”

12.zh: 我就照着所吩咐的去行，白日带出我的物件，好像预备掳去使用的物件。到了晚上，我用手挖通了墙。天黑的时候，就当他们眼前搭在肩头上带出去。
12.en: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.

12.zh: 次日早晨，耶和华的话临到我说：
12.en: In the morning, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

12.zh: 「人子啊，以色列家，就是那悖逆之家，岂不是问你说：『你做什么呢？』
12.en: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’

12.zh: 你要对他们说：『主耶和华如此说：这是[关乎]耶路撒冷的君王和他周围以色列全家的预表。』
12.en: “Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’

12.zh: 你要说：『我作你们的预兆：我怎样行，他们所遭遇的也必怎样，他们必被掳去。』
12.en: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.

12.zh: 他们中间的君王也必在天黑的时候将物件搭在肩头上带出去。他们要挖通了墙，从其中带出去。他必蒙住脸，眼看不见地。
12.en: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.

12.zh: 我必将我的网撒在他身上，他必在我的网罗中缠住。我必带他到迦勒底人之地的巴比伦；他虽死在那里，却看不见那地。
12.en: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.

12.zh: 周围一切帮助他的和他所有的军队，我必分散四方，也要拔刀追赶他们。
12.en: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.

12.zh: 我将他们四散在列国、分散在列邦的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。
12.en: “‘They will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

12.zh: 我却要留下他们几个人得免刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫，使他们在所到的各国中述说他们一切可憎的事，人就知道我是耶和华。」
12.en: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

12.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
12.en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

12.zh: 「人子啊，你吃饭必胆战，喝水必惶惶忧虑。
12.en: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.

12.zh: 你要对这地的百姓说：主耶和华论耶路撒冷和以色列地的居民如此说，他们吃饭必忧虑，喝水必惊惶。因其中居住的众人所行强暴的事，这地必然荒废，一无所存。
12.en: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord GOD says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.

12.zh: 有居民的城邑必变为荒场，地也必变为荒废；你们就知道我是耶和华。」
12.en: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”

12.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
12.en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

12.zh: 「人子啊，在你们以色列地怎么有这俗语，说『日子迟延，一切异象都落了空』呢？
12.en: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?

12.zh: 你要告诉他们说：『主耶和华如此说：我必使这俗语止息，以色列中不再用这俗语。』你却要对他们说：『日子临近，一切的异象必都应验。』
12.en: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

12.zh: 从此，在以色列家中必不再有虚假的异象和奉承的占卜。
12.en: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

12.zh: 我—耶和华说话，所说的必定成就，不再耽延。你们这悖逆之家，我所说的话必趁你们在世的日子成就。这是主耶和华说的。」
12.en: For I am the LORD. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord GOD.’”

12.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
12.en: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

12.zh: 「人子啊，以色列家的人说：『他所见的异象是关乎后来许多的日子，所说的预言是指着极远的时候。』
12.en: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’

12.zh: 所以你要对他们说：『主耶和华如此说：我的话没有一句再耽延的，我所说的必定成就。这是主耶和华说的。』」
12.en: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord GOD.’”

13.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
13.en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

13.zh: 「人子啊，你要说预言攻击以色列中说预言的先知，对那些本己心发预言的说：『你们当听耶和华的话。』」
13.en: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear the LORD’s word:

13.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「愚顽的先知有祸了，他们随从自己的心意，却一无所见。
13.en: The Lord GOD says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

13.zh: 以色列啊，你的先知好像荒场中的狐狸，
13.en: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.

13.zh: 没有上去堵挡破口，也没有为以色列家重修墙垣，使他们当耶和华的日子在阵上站立得住。
13.en: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the LORD’s day.

13.zh: 这些人所见的是虚假，是谎诈的占卜。他们说是耶和华说的，其实耶和华并没有差遣他们，他们倒使人指望那话必然立定。
13.en: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘The LORD says;’ but the LORD has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.

13.zh: 你们岂不是见了虚假的异象吗？岂不是说了谎诈的占卜吗？你们说，这是耶和华说的，其实我没有说。」
13.en: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘The LORD says;’ but I have not spoken?”

13.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：「因你们说的是虚假，见的是谎诈，我就与你们反对。这是主耶和华说的。
13.en: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord GOD.

13.zh: 我的手必攻击那见虚假异象、用谎诈占卜的先知，他们必不列在我百姓的会中，不录在以色列家的册上，也不进入以色列地；你们就知道我是主耶和华。
13.en: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.”

13.zh: 因为他们诱惑我的百姓，说：『平安！』其实没有平安，就像有人立起墙壁，他们倒用未泡透的[灰]抹上。
13.en: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.

13.zh: 所以你要对那些抹上未泡透[灰]的人说：『墙要倒塌，必有暴雨漫过。大冰雹啊，你们要降下，狂风也要吹裂这墙。』
13.en: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.

13.zh: 这墙倒塌之后，人岂不问你们说：『你们抹上未泡透的[灰]在哪里呢？』」
13.en: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”

13.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：「我要发怒，使狂风吹裂这墙，在怒中使暴雨漫过，又发怒降下大冰雹，毁灭这墙。
13.en: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

13.zh: 我要这样拆毁你们那未泡透[灰]所抹的墙，拆平到地，以致根基露出，墙必倒塌，你们也必在其中灭亡；你们就知道我是耶和华。
13.en: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

13.zh: 我要这样向墙和用未泡透[灰]抹墙的人成就我怒中所定的，并要对你们说：『墙和抹墙的人都没有了。』
13.en: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—

13.zh: 这[抹墙的]就是以色列的先知，他们指着耶路撒冷说预言，为这城见了平安的异象，其实没有平安。这是主耶和华说的。」
13.en: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord GOD.’”

13.zh: 「人子啊，你要面向本民中、从己心发预言的女子说预言，攻击她们，
13.en: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,

13.zh: 说主耶和华如此说：『这些妇女有祸了！她们为众人的膀臂缝靠枕，给高矮之人做下垂的头巾，为要猎取人的性命。难道你们要猎取我百姓的性命，为利己将人救活吗？
13.en: and say, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?

13.zh: 你们为两把大麦，为几块饼，在我民中亵渎我，对肯听谎言的民说谎，杀死不该死的人，救活不该活的人。』」
13.en: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’

13.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：「看哪，我与你们的靠枕反对，就是你们用以猎取人、使人的性命[如鸟]飞的。我要将靠枕从你们的膀臂上扯去，释放你们猎取[如鸟]飞的人。
13.en: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.

13.zh: 我也必撕裂你们下垂的头巾，救我百姓脱离你们的手，不再被猎取，落在你们手中。你们就知道我是耶和华。
13.en: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

13.zh: 我不使义人伤心，你们却以谎话使他伤心，又坚固恶人的手，使他不回头离开恶道得以救活。
13.en: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.

13.zh: 你们就不再见虚假的异象，也不再行占卜的事；我必救我的百姓脱离你们的手；你们就知道我是耶和华。」
13.en: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”

14.zh: 有几个以色列长老到我这里来，坐在我面前。
14.en: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

14.zh: 耶和华的话就临到我说：
14.en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

14.zh: 「人子啊，这些人已将他们的假神接到心里，把陷于罪的绊脚石放在面前，我岂能丝毫被他们求问吗？
14.en: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?

14.zh: 所以你要告诉他们：『主耶和华如此说：以色列家的人中，凡将他的假神接到心里，把陷于罪的绊脚石放在面前，又就了先知来的，我—耶和华在他所求的事上，必按他众多的假神回答他，
14.en: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,

14.zh: 好在以色列家的心事上捉住他们，因为他们都借着假神与我生疏。』
14.en: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’

14.zh: 「所以你要告诉以色列家说：『主耶和华如此说：回头吧！离开你们的偶像，转脸莫从你们一切可憎的事。』
14.en: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.

14.zh: 因为以色列家的人，或在以色列中寄居的外人，凡与我隔绝，将他的假神接到心里，把陷于罪的绊脚石放在面前，又就了先知来要为自己的事求问我的，我—耶和华必亲自回答他。
14.en: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I the LORD will answer him by myself.

14.zh: 我必向那人变脸，使他作了警戒，笑谈，令人惊骇，并且我要将他从我民中剪除；你们就知道我是耶和华。
14.en: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

14.zh: 先知若被迷惑说一句预言，是我—耶和华任那先知受迷惑，我也必向他伸手，将他从我民以色列中除灭。
14.en: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, the LORD, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.

14.zh: 他们必担当自己的罪孽。先知的罪孽和求问之人的罪孽都是一样，
14.en: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,

14.zh: 好使以色列家不再走迷离开我，不再因各样的罪过玷污自己，只要作我的子民，我作他们的　神。这是主耶和华说的。」
14.en: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord GOD.’”

14.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
14.en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

14.zh: 「人子啊，若有一国犯罪干犯我，我也向他伸手折断他们的杖，就是断绝他们的粮，使饥荒临到那地，将人与牲畜从其中剪除；
14.en: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—

14.zh: 其中虽有挪亚、但以理、约伯这三人，他们只能因他们的义救自己的性命。这是主耶和华说的。
14.en: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord GOD.

14.zh: 我若使恶兽经过糟践那地，使地荒凉，以致因这些兽，人都不得经过；
14.en: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—

14.zh: 虽有这三人在其中，主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，他们连儿带女都不能得救，只能自己得救，那地仍然荒凉。
14.en: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.

14.zh: 或者我使刀剑临到那地，说：刀剑哪，要经过那地，以致我将人与牲畜从其中剪除；
14.en: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—

14.zh: 虽有这三人在其中，主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，他们连儿带女都不能得救，只能自己得救。
14.en: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.

14.zh: 或者我叫瘟疫流行那地，使我灭命的忿怒倾在其上，好将人与牲畜从其中剪除；
14.en: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—

14.zh: 虽有挪亚、但以理、约伯在其中，主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，他们连儿带女都不能救，只能因他们的义救自己的性命。」
14.en: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”

14.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「我将这四样大灾—就是刀剑、饥荒、恶兽、瘟疫降在耶路撒冷，将人与牲畜从其中剪除，岂不更重吗？
14.en: For the Lord GOD says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!

14.zh: 然而其中必有剩下的人，他们连儿带女必带到你们这里来，你们看见他们所行所为的，要因我降给耶路撒冷的一切灾祸，便得了安慰。
14.en: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.

14.zh: 你们看见他们所行所为的，得了安慰，就知道我在耶路撒冷中所行的并非无故。这是主耶和华说的。」
14.en: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord GOD.

15.en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

15.zh: 「人子啊，葡萄树比别样树有什么强处？葡萄枝比众树枝有什么好处？
15.en: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?

15.zh: 其上可以取木料做什么工用，可以取来做钉子挂什么器皿吗？
15.en: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?

15.zh: 看哪，已经抛在火中当作柴烧，火既烧了两头，中间也被烧了，还有益于工用吗？
15.en: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?

15.zh: 完全的时候尚且不合乎什么工用，何况被火烧坏，还能合乎什么工用吗？」
15.en: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”

15.zh: 所以，主耶和华如此说：「众树以内的葡萄树，我怎样使它在火中当柴，也必照样待耶路撒冷的居民。
15.en: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

15.zh: 我必向他们变脸；他们虽从火中出来，火却要烧灭他们。我向他们变脸的时候，你们就知道我是耶和华。
15.en: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.

15.zh: 我必使地土荒凉，因为他们行事干犯我。这是主耶和华说的。」
15.en: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord GOD.

16.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
16.en: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

16.zh: 「人子啊，你要使耶路撒冷知道她那些可憎的事，
16.en: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;

16.zh: 说主耶和华对耶路撒冷如此说：你根本，你出世，是在迦南地；你父亲是亚摩利人，你母亲是赫人。
16.en: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.

16.zh: 论到你出世的景况，在你初生的日子没有为你断脐带，也没有用水洗你，使你洁净，丝毫没有撒盐在你身上，也没有用布裹你。
16.en: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.

16.zh: 谁的眼也不可怜你，为你做一件这样的事怜恤你；但你初生的日子扔在田野，是因你被厌恶。
16.en: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.

16.zh: 「我从你旁边经过，见你滚在血中，就对你说：[你虽]在血中，仍可存活；[你虽]在血中，仍可存活。
16.en: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’

16.zh: 我使你生长好像田间所长的，你就渐渐长大，以致极其俊美，两乳成形，头发长成，你却仍然赤身露体。
16.en: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.

16.zh: 「我从你旁边经过，看见你的时候正动爱情，便用衣襟搭在你身上，遮盖你的赤体；又向你起誓，与你结盟，你就归于我。这是主耶和华说的。
16.en: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord GOD, “and you became mine.

16.zh: 那时我用水洗你，洗净你身上的血，又用油抹你。
16.en: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

16.zh: 我也使你身穿绣花衣服，脚穿海狗皮鞋，并用细麻布给你束腰，用丝绸为衣披在你身上，
16.en: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.

16.zh: 又用妆饰打扮你，将镯子戴在你手上，将金链戴在你项上。
16.en: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.

16.zh: 我也将环子戴在你鼻子上，将耳环戴在你耳朵上，将华冠戴在你头上。
16.en: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

16.zh: 这样，你就有金银的妆饰，穿的是细麻衣和丝绸，并绣花衣；吃的是细面、蜂蜜，并油。你也极其美貌，发达到王后的尊荣。
16.en: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.

16.zh: 你美貌的名声传在列邦中，你十分美貌，是因我加在你身上的威荣。这是主耶和华说的。
16.en: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord GOD.

16.zh: 「只是你仗着自己的美貌，又因你的名声就行邪淫。你纵情淫乱，使过路的任意而行。
16.en: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.

16.zh: 你用衣服为自己在高处结彩，在其上行邪淫。[这样的事]将来必没有，也必不再行了。
16.en: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.

16.zh: 你又将我所给你那华美的金银、宝器为自己制造人像，与他行邪淫；
16.en: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.

16.zh: 又用你的绣花衣服给他披上，并将我的膏油和香料摆在他跟前；
16.en: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.

16.zh: 又将我赐给你的食物，就是我赐给你吃的细面、油，和蜂蜜，都摆在他跟前为馨香[的供物]。这是主耶和华说的。
16.en: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord GOD.

16.zh: 并且你将给我所生的儿女焚献给他。
16.en: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,

16.zh: 你行淫乱岂是小事，竟将我的儿女杀了，使他们经[火]归与他吗？
16.en: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?

16.zh: 你行这一切可憎和淫乱的事，并未追念你幼年赤身露体滚在血中的日子。」
16.en: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.

16.zh: 「你行这一切恶事之后（主耶和华说：你有祸了！有祸了！）
16.en: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord GOD—

16.zh: 又为自己建造圆顶花楼，在各街上做了高台。
16.en: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.

16.zh: 你在一切市口上建造高台，使你的美貌变为可憎的，又与一切过路的多行淫乱。
16.en: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.

16.zh: 你也和你邻邦放纵情欲的埃及人行淫，加增你的淫乱，惹我发怒。
16.en: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.

16.zh: 因此我伸手攻击你，减少你应用的[粮食]，又将你交给恨你的非利士众女，使她们任意待你。她们见你的淫行，为你羞耻。
16.en: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.

16.zh: 你因贪色无厌，又与亚述人行淫，与他们行淫之后，仍不满意，
16.en: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.

16.zh: 并且多行淫乱，直到那贸易之地，就是迦勒底，你仍不满意。
16.en: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.

16.zh: 「主耶和华说：你行这一切事，都是不知羞耻妓女所行的，可见你的心是何等懦弱！
16.en: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord GOD, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;

16.zh: 因你在一切市口上建造圆顶花楼，在各街上做了高台，你却藐视赏赐，不像妓女。
16.en: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.

16.zh: 哎！你这行淫的妻啊，宁肯接外人，不接丈夫。
16.en: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!

16.zh: 凡妓女是得人赠送，你反倒赠送你所爱的人，贿赂他们从四围来与你行淫。
16.en: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.

16.zh: 你行淫与[别的]妇女相反，因为不是人从你行淫；你既赠送人，人并不赠送你；所以你与别的妇女相反。」
16.en: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’

16.zh: 「你这妓女啊，要听耶和华的话。
16.en: “Therefore, prostitute, hear the LORD’s word:

16.zh: 主耶和华如此说：因你的污秽倾泄了，你与你所爱的行淫露出下体，又因你拜一切可憎的偶像，流儿女的血献给他，
16.en: ‘The Lord GOD says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;

16.zh: 我就要将你一切相欢相爱的和你一切所恨的都聚集来，从四围攻击你；又将你的下体露出，使他们看尽了。
16.en: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

16.zh: 我也要审判你，好像[官长]审判淫妇和流人血的妇女一样。我因忿怒忌恨，使流血的罪归到你身上。
16.en: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.

16.zh: 我又要将你交在他们手中；他们必拆毁你的圆顶花楼，毁坏你的高台，剥去你的衣服，夺取你的华美宝器，留下你赤身露体。
16.en: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.

16.zh: 他们也必带多人来攻击你，用石头打死你，用刀剑刺透你，
16.en: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

16.zh: 用火焚烧你的房屋，在许多妇人眼前向你施行审判。我必使你不再行淫，也不再赠送与人。
16.en: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.

16.zh: 这样，我就止息向你发的忿怒，我的忌恨也要离开你，我要安静不再恼怒。
16.en: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.

16.zh: 因你不追念你幼年的日子，在这一切的事上向我发烈怒，所以我必照你所行的报应在你头上，你就不再贪淫，行那一切可憎的事。这是主耶和华说的。」
16.en: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord GOD: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.

16.zh: 「凡说俗语的必用俗语攻击你，说：『母亲怎样，女儿也怎样。』
16.en: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’

16.zh: 你正是你母亲的女儿，厌弃丈夫和儿女；你正是你姊妹的姊妹，厌弃丈夫和儿女。你母亲是赫人，你父亲是亚摩利人。
16.en: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

16.zh: 你的姊姊是撒马利亚，她和她的众女住在你左边；你的妹妹是所多玛，她和她的众女住在你右边。
16.en: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.

16.zh: 你没有效法她们的行为，也没有照她们可憎的事去做，你以那为小事，你一切所行的倒比她们更坏。
16.en: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.

16.zh: 主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，你妹妹所多玛与她的众女尚未行你和你众女所行的事。
16.en: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.

16.zh: 看哪，你妹妹所多玛的罪孽是这样：她和她的众女都心骄气傲，粮食饱足，大享安逸，并没有扶助困苦和穷乏人的手。
16.en: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

16.zh: 她们狂傲，在我面前行可憎的事，我看见便将她们除掉。
16.en: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.

16.zh: 撒马利亚没有犯你一半的罪，你行可憎的事比她更多，使你的姊妹因你所行一切可憎的事，倒显为义。
16.en: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.

16.zh: 你既断定你姊妹为义，就要担当自己的羞辱；因你所犯的罪比她们更为可憎，她们就比你更显为义；你既使你的姊妹显为义，你就要抱愧担当自己的羞辱。」
16.en: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.

16.zh: 「我必叫她们被掳的归回，就是叫所多玛和她的众女，撒马利亚和她的众女，并你们中间被掳的，都要归回，
16.en: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;

16.zh: 好使你担当自己的羞辱，并因你一切所行的使她们得安慰，你就抱愧。
16.en: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.

16.zh: 你的妹妹所多玛和她的众女必归回原位；撒马利亚和她的众女，你和你的众女，也必归回原位。
16.en: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.

16.zh: 在你骄傲的日子，你的恶行没有显露以先，你的口就不提你的妹妹所多玛。那受了凌辱的亚兰众女和亚兰四围非利士的众女都恨恶你，藐视你。
16.en: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.

16.zh: 耶和华说：你贪淫和可憎的事，你已经担当了。」
16.en: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says the LORD.

16.zh: 「主耶和华如此说：你这轻看誓言、背弃盟约的，我必照你所行的待你。
16.en: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

16.zh: 然而我要追念在你幼年时与你所立的约，也要与你立定永约。
16.en: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

16.zh: 你接待你姊姊和你妹妹的时候，你要追念你所行的，自觉惭愧；并且我要将她们赐你为女儿，却不是按着前约。
16.en: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.

16.zh: 我要坚定与你所立的约（你就知道我是耶和华），
16.en: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am the LORD;

16.zh: 好使你在我赦免你一切所行的时候，心里追念，自觉抱愧，又因你的羞辱就不再开口。这是主耶和华说的。」
16.en: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord GOD.’”

17.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
17.en: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

17.zh: 「人子啊，你要向以色列家出谜语，设比喻，
17.en: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;

17.zh: 说主耶和华如此说：有一大鹰，翅膀大，翎毛长，羽毛丰满，彩色俱备，来到黎巴嫩，将香柏树梢拧去，
17.en: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.

17.zh: 就是折去香柏树尽尖的嫩枝，叼到贸易之地，放在买卖城中；
17.en: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.

17.zh: 又将以色列地的枝子栽于肥田里，插在大水旁，如插柳树，
17.en: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.

17.zh: 就渐渐生长，成为蔓延矮小的葡萄树。其枝转向那鹰，其根在鹰以下，于是成了葡萄树，生出枝子，发出小枝。
17.en: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.

17.zh: 「又有一大鹰，翅膀大，羽毛多。这葡萄树从栽种的畦中向这鹰弯过根来，发出枝子，好得它的浇灌。
17.en: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.

17.zh: 这树栽于肥田多水的旁边，好生枝子，结果子，成为佳美的葡萄树。
17.en: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’

17.zh: 你要说，主耶和华如此说：这葡萄树岂能发旺呢？鹰岂不拔出它的根来，芟除它的果子，使它枯干，使它发的嫩叶都枯干了吗？也不用大力和多民，就拔出它的根来。
17.en: “Say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.

17.zh: 葡萄树虽然栽种，岂能发旺呢？一经东风，岂不全然枯干吗？必在生长的畦中枯干了。」
17.en: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”

17.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
17.en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

17.zh: 「你对那悖逆之家说：你们不知道这些事是什么意思吗？你要告诉他们说，巴比伦王曾到耶路撒冷，将其中的君王和首领带到巴比伦自己那里去。
17.en: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.

17.zh: 从以色列的宗室中取一人与他立约，使他发誓，并将国中有势力的人掳去，
17.en: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,

17.zh: 使国低微不能自强，惟因守盟约得以存立。
17.en: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

17.zh: 他却背叛巴比伦王，打发使者往埃及去，要他们给他马匹和多民。他岂能亨通呢？行这样事的人岂能逃脱呢？他背约岂能逃脱呢？
17.en: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?

17.zh: 他轻看向王所起的誓，背弃王与他所立的约。主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，他定要死在立他作王、巴比伦王的京都。
17.en: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.

17.zh: 敌人筑垒造台，与他打仗的时候，为要剪除多人，法老虽领大军队和大群众，还是不能帮助他。
17.en: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.

17.zh: 他轻看誓言，背弃盟约，已经投降，却又做这一切的事，他必不能逃脱。」
17.en: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.

17.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：「我指着我的永生起誓，他既轻看指我所起的誓，背弃指我所立的约，我必要使这罪归在他头上。
17.en: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.

17.zh: 我必将我的网撒在他身上，他必在我的网罗中缠住。我必带他到巴比伦，并要在那里因他干犯我的罪刑罚他。
17.en: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.

17.zh: 他的一切军队，凡逃跑的，都必倒在刀下；所剩下的，也必分散四方。你们就知道说这话的是我—耶和华。」
17.en: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it.’

17.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「我要将香柏树梢拧去栽上，就是从尽尖的嫩枝中折一嫩枝，栽于极高的山上；
17.en: “The Lord GOD says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

17.zh: 在以色列高处的山栽上。它就生枝子，结果子，成为佳美的香柏树，各类飞鸟都必宿在其下，就是宿在枝子的荫下。
17.en: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.

17.zh: 田野的树木都必知道我—耶和华使高树矮小，矮树高大；青树枯干，枯树发旺。我—耶和华如此说，也如此行了。」
